issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

auths.description:
If set, then this {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Auth} represents a combination of multiple auths.
NOTE: if specified, then the auths referenced will be used - other fields in this instance will
be ignored.

As an analogy, if a specific auth is a "key", then this enables the ability to
specify "keychains" based on existing "keys".
See {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Completion.Client#router} for an example for where the
"keychain" concept may be used.

serviceAccountInfo.description:
The authentication key for the service account.
The string should be a json dump of the service account json.
An example of this can be found on {@link https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers/vertex#system-message}.

project.description: The Google Cloud Project ID or number.
